title: fix(components,react): element:* nodes render the spec's nested aria as real attributes through one shared reader (objectui#11051)
body:
Fixes #11051
Clause-②: yes
Why yes (copied from the claim): a new public export from `@object-ui/react` widens a published surface, as the retriage answer declares; contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` before landing.

## What changed

Route: **A2 with Q2-a**, the retriage answer on the card (comment `5886920927`).

- **New export: `resolveInlineAriaProps(aria, locale)` from `@object-ui/react`.** It lives in its own module, `packages/react/src/utils/inlineAria.ts`, and the entry `packages/react/src/index.ts` exports it by name beside `resolveKeyedI18nLabel`. That is the pattern the entry already uses for `resolveKeyedI18nLabel` and `isConfigBag`. It is a pure function that reads no React context. It maps the spec's nested `AriaProps`:
  - `ariaLabel` → `aria-label`, resolved with the spec's `resolveI18nLabel` (from `@objectstack/spec/ui`, installed 17.4.0) against the locale passed in;
  - `ariaDescribedBy` → `aria-describedby`;
  - `role` → `role`.

  It returns only the attributes that have a value, so a spread never writes an empty or `undefined` attribute. It adds no alias for keys the spec refuses.
- **`SchemaRenderer`'s flat `resolveAriaProps` is unchanged.** It is still module-private, still reads the flat node keys, and still resolves in the keyed vocabulary. Its JSDoc now says so and points at the nested reader. The old docblock's "AriaPropsSchema defines…" wording is what sent the card's first direction to the wrong reader.
- **`packages/components/src/renderers/basic/elements.tsx`:** the file-local `ariaAttrs` is deleted. All five read sites now spread `resolveInlineAriaProps(props.aria, locale)`: `element:text`, `element:image`, `element:button`, and `element:number`'s value and its "no object named" notice. The file holds no mapping table. The `aria` prop is typed as the spec's `AriaProps` (through `@object-ui/types`) instead of an untyped record.
- **Locale:** each call site passes `useDisplayLocale()` from `@object-ui/i18n`. That is what the two existing nested-aria readers pass (ListView, and `plugin-detail`'s `useRecordAriaProps`), and what every `resolveI18nLabel` read site in `@object-ui/components` passes under objectui#4580 revised Q1-A (`filter-builder`, `sidebar`, `dropdown-menu`). `element:number` already called it. `element:image` calls it before its early return, so the hook order is the same with and without a `src`.
- **Docs:** a `resolveInlineAriaProps` section in `packages/react/README.md` (AGENTS.md, commandment 2: docs-driven), and the changeset `.changeset/11051-inline-aria-reader.md` (`@object-ui/react` minor, `@object-ui/components` patch). The changeset says what an author sees change (`aria-label` instead of `aria-arialabel`), names the new export, and describes what is no longer read.

**What is no longer read (the break, in the changeset prose).** The old helper passed raw `aria-*` keys through, and turned any other key into `aria-KEY`, so a spec-refused `aria: { label }` rendered `aria-label` by accident. These four elements now read only the three declared keys. Measured producers, at `b31591b4a`, with `git grep` for an `aria` bag opener in the non-test files that author `element:text` / `button` / `image` / `number`: 42 files in objectui, 3 carry an opener (the `en` locale pack, a CHANGELOG, a `SchemaRenderer` comment). In ObjectStack `origin/main` there are 37 files, 4 carry an opener (the spec CHANGELOG, two liveness ledgers, a list/form conversion fixture). None of those openers is on one of these four elements. The same opener hitting those files is the matcher's positive control.

**Card premise, re-measured at `b31591b4a`:** `elements.tsx` has five `ariaAttrs(` call sites plus the definition, not six call sites. The previous report on the card made the same correction.

## Tests (at `96781deef` unless stated)

- **Reader unit pin:** `packages/react/src/utils/inlineAria.test.ts`, 8 tests. It covers a plain string under en and zh, a locale map under en / zh / zh-CN / `undefined`, `ariaDescribedBy`, `role`, all three together, a missing bag / `null` / a non-object, empty values, unknown keys (`label`, raw `aria-label`, `live`), and the flat keyed resolver returning `undefined` for the same map. It uses `toStrictEqual`, so no `undefined`-valued key can hide in the result.
- **Render pin:** `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/__tests__/elements.inlineAria-11051.test.tsx`, 27 tests, through the real `SchemaRenderer` and registry inside an `I18nProvider`. On each of the five read sites it checks that:
  - a plain string under en and under zh renders `aria-label`;
  - a locale map renders the en entry under en and the zh entry under zh;
  - `ariaDescribedBy` renders `aria-describedby`, and `role` renders `role`;
  - the attribute sits on the expected element (`P` / `BUTTON` / `IMG` / `DIV`);
  - no `aria-arialabel` is rendered.

  The control is a `container` with the flat keyed `ariaLabel`: a plain string and a keyed `{ key, defaultValue }` reference both still render `aria-label`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/react/` → `Test Files  103 passed (103)`, `Tests  1359 passed (1359)`.
- Consumer radius: every test file under `packages/` and `apps/` that authors an `element:text` / `button` / `image` / `number` node, plus all of `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/` (76 files; the 5 in `packages/react` ran above). `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over the other 71 → `Test Files  71 passed (71)`, `Tests  1867 passed (1867)`.
- **Ablation (at `3f6f020d8`, fix committed first):** `elements.tsx` was checked out from the base `b31591b4a` inside a trap-restored script. On disk: `ariaAttrs` 0 → 6 and `resolveInlineAriaProps` 7 → 0. Run: `Tests  25 failed | 2 passed (27)`. The direction is red, and the 2 that pass are the flat-keyed controls. Restored: the file's blob hash equals the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The test resolves `@object-ui/react` and `elements.tsx` through the vitest source alias, so no `dist` sits in that path.
- **Reverse type check:** a throwaway `packages/components/src` probe calling `resolveInlineAriaProps({ ariaLabel: 42 }, 'en')` made `tsc --noEmit` exit 2 with TS2322. So `@object-ui/components` reads the rebuilt `@object-ui/react` declaration. The probe was removed and `git status` was empty afterwards.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/react type-check` → 0; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check` → 0. Both run `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, and `--listFilesOnly` confirms that each `tsconfig.test.json` includes the new test files.

**Declared narrowing.**
- **Lint.** The population is the root `eslint.config.js` (`**/*.{ts,tsx}`, the one config). The file count is 6, read from `--format json`. Invariance: the config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`), and no custom rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem, so this diff cannot change the verdict on an untouched file.
- **Tests.** The consumer radius comes from a `git grep` of test source. A test that loads `element:*` nodes from a JSON or example fixture is outside it, and so are the other `packages/components` tests and the `dist` project (`test:dist`). CI's `pnpm test` covers them.

## Acceptance notes

- **The name on an element whose role prohibits naming.** `element:text` renders `p` / `h2` / `h3`, and `element:number` renders a `div`. An `aria-label` without a `role` on a `p` or a `div` (roles `paragraph` / `generic`) is not exposed by browsers. The reader emits the author's `role` when one is declared. `useRecordAriaProps` supplies a default role for this reason; the element family does not. Not measured in a browser. Carrier: the A1 follow-up that moves `useRecordAriaProps` onto this reader and brings its `defaultRole` with it.
- **Two locale channels inside one node.** The visible `content` / `label` of `element:text` / `element:button` resolve through `pickLocalized(…, useObjectTranslation().language)`, which predates this PR. The new `aria-label` resolves against `useDisplayLocale()` (the tenant display locale first, then the UI language). They differ only when a tenant display locale is configured and differs from the UI language. Observed, not measured. Carrier: none.
- `element:image`'s no-`src` placeholder takes no `aria` bag and prints a hard-coded English literal. It is not one of the read sites the ruling names, so it is untouched here. Carrier: none.
- The page root's nested `aria` (the previous report's finding on this card) is untouched. The new reader could serve it.

## Follow-ups for the seat to file (A2)

- Move ListView's inline nested-aria mapping in `plugin-list` onto `resolveInlineAriaProps`.
- Move `plugin-detail`'s `useRecordAriaProps` (`recordComponentAria.ts`) onto it, keeping its `defaultRole` / `defaultLabel` / refused-`label` report.
